tagline: Babies hold a meeting about you. Real parenting wisdom, 40 seconds, motion carried.
format: One parenting topic per Short. Five different babies (Chair, Sassy, Wise, Dramatic, Closer), one line each, 8 s per clip, spoken to camera. The Closer ends with 'Motion carried.' and a newborn reaction.
style_prompt: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic, cinematic shallow depth of field, soft warm window light, gentle pastel nursery colours, natural baby skin texture, shot on a 50mm lens
audio_prompt: No music. No subtitles, no captions, no text on screen.
negative_prompt: text, subtitles, logos, brands, celebrities, real identifiable people, unsafe sleep setups, babies left unattended near hazards

content_rules: Babies are AI-generated; never name them, never claim they are real children.
Evidence-based, mainstream parenting ideas only. No medical, sleep-training, feeding or legal advice beyond general guidance; no products or brands.
Line 1 is always the Chair opening the meeting; line 5 is the Closer ending 'Motion carried.'
Each line <= 18 words so Veo can say it naturally in 8 s.
Humour is kind: the babies tease parents lovingly, never shame them.
ai_disclosure: The babies in this video are AI-generated characters (Google Veo). The parenting tips are general guidance, not professional advice.
